svg.text: Peristalsis: rhythmic wave-like muscle contractions that mix and push food along the gut.
The teeth chew the food into small pieces,
and salivary amylase begins to digest starch.
It carries the food from the mouth to the
Its acid and protease (pepsin) digest protein,
and its muscular wall churns the food.
It makes amylase, protease and lipase, which
Bile and pancreatic enzymes are added here
Digested food is absorbed into the blood
The liver makes bile, which emulsifies fats;
the gall bladder stores the bile.
The colon absorbs water; faeces are stored in
the rectum and egested at the anus.
